Thanks for taking this — we're excited to move BridgeMark onto Redwood. Attached is our current MSA (BridgeMark_MSA_v1.pdf) and a short note about the Order Form we intend to use. High level asks from our side to start the intake: 

- Can Redwood confirm whether you can accept an EU data residency carve for payment processing data (subset only)?
- We need an initial redline on the MSA + a view of any additional exhibit content you expect for hosting/tech (Exhibit B: technical boundaries).
- Billing contact for PO / invoice routing: Tom Reed (tom.reed@bridgemark.com).
- We have a SOC 2 report available (link below) and can share a cert bundle once NDA is in place.

Attached: BridgeMark_MSA_v1.pdf (draft), short Order Form note.

Would appreciate a recommended intake checklist and a proposed 3–5 business day timeline for first-pass redlines.

Best,

Hi Sarah — thanks for the MSA and for the clear asks. Copying Kim and Marissa to triage.

Quick intake checklist from our side (we can send a filled template if helpful):
- Confirm official BridgeMark counterparty name and signatory (please fill party sheet)
- Confirm billing contact and PO cadence (invoice address / tax info)
- Identify desired data residency band (exact datasets/paths)
- Share any non-standard SLAs or uptime requirements expected in Order Form
- Security evidence: SOC 2 report + any specific compliance artifacts (we'll ask Kim for evidence matrix)

Owners at Redwood: Marissa will lead commercial redlines + Order Form mapping; Kim will own security/compliance evidence and the SOC 2 review.

Proposed timeline: initial redline (commercial + issues log) within 3 business days after we receive the completed party sheet and Order Form draft. Can you populate the attached party sheet (BridgeMark_party_sheet.csv) and include the signatory name and region carve specifics?

If that works I can schedule a 30-min kickoff for Friday (06/12) to walk scope and any technical exhibits.

Sarah / Lukas — Marissa here, I'll take point on the redlines and Order Form alignment. A few commercial priorities from our side so we can triage quickly:

Priority clause areas (initial pass):
- Liability cap language (please confirm whether BridgeMark requests unlimited liability for certain waivers)
- Data residency carve and permitted transfers (we need exact dataset list)
- Indemnity scope: third-party claims and patent carveouts
- SLA and remedies (Order Form should list target lat/availability per environment)
- Export controls / restricted use language (if you have restricted countries list, flag it)

Please send the draft Order Form SKU map (or a spreadsheet) so we can map pricing/tier clauses. Also confirm the signature authority name and whether countersign will be electronic (DocuSign) or wet signature.

I'll prepare a redline guide (short doc) and aim to return a first-pass MSA redline + annotated issues log within 72 hours after we have the completed party sheet + Order Form draft.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
